info.title: Runnelix development API
info.description: Local development API. Literal loopback Host required; browser Origin must equal configured RUNNELIX_BROWSER_ORIGIN. Workspace paths scope data but are not user authentication. The runs POST route remains admission-only; execute POST runs the pinned graph. Requests <=256 KiB; run inputs and node payloads <=8 KiB. Lists have a stable ID cursor and 50-row pages. Credentials are write-only and encrypted; metadata includes destination and grants are explicit. Optional oidc mode verifies identity tokens and enforces issuer/subject workspace memberships on every workspace route. Roles and explicit publish, execute, and dataRead grants govern access. See docs/implementation/phase-5-memberships.md. Development mode remains loopback-only.
